# Original unicode-collation 0.1.3.7

All regular source, data and test files are unchanged from the Hackage release.

Archive: https://hackage.haskell.org/package/unicode-collation-0.1.3.7/unicode-collation-0.1.3.7.tar.gz

SHA-256: `ec7f75d635486d760bf45d2093ff380b1dad4146ceee39107d66cd00af713c57`.

This version satisfies Pandoc's original `>=0.1.1 && <0.2` dependency bound.
The Lang oracle compiles its unchanged module directly and includes the
original language-test definitions. The other collation implementation and
all remaining original tests are retained but not claimed as ported.
